name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_authorize_with_youtube
summary: Check or renew YouTube authorization for a channel already connected to vidIQ. Use when the user requests authorization, before operations requiring fresh authentication, or after an authorization handoff. Show the authorization link or widget when required and wait for completion. If no channel is connected, use vidiq_connect_youtube_channel. Does not modify videos or comments.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_balance
summary: Check how many vidIQ credits the user has left.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_bookmarks_list
summary: List the user's saved videos, channels, keywords and creations in vidIQ.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_bookmarks_remove
summary: Remove an item from the user's vidIQ bookmarks.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_bookmarks_save
summary: Save a video, channel or keyword to the user's vidIQ bookmarks.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_channel_analytics
summary: Get YouTube Studio analytics for the user's connected channel, including views, watch time, subscribers, retention, traffic sources, audience and revenue.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_channel_performance_trends
summary: See how quickly a YouTube channel's videos typically gain views after publishing. Returns typical view-growth patterns for comparing a new upload with the channel's normal pace.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_channel_search
summary: Find YouTube channels in a niche or by name, filtered by channel size, growth and Shorts or long-form posting activity.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_channel_stats
summary: Get a YouTube channel's public subscriber, view and video counts, plus growth over a period.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_channel_videos
summary: List a public YouTube channel's newest or most popular uploads, including long-form videos, Shorts and live videos.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_comment_insights
summary: Find recurring viewer questions, requests and pain points in YouTube comments across a niche. Returns comment-based insights for video ideas and signs of audience demand.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_comment_reply_permission
summary: Check whether the current YouTube session and the selected channel allow comment replies. Use once after returning from YouTube authorization. This does not post a reply or start authorization.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_compose
summary: Assemble clips or images with voiceover, background music and supplied text overlays into a finished MP4 video.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_connect_instagram_account
summary: Connect the user's Instagram account to vidIQ.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_connect_youtube_channel
summary: Connect a YouTube channel to the user's vidIQ account. Use when the user requests a connection or another tool reports no connected channel. Show the authorization widget or link and wait for completion. Connecting the first channel establishes fresh authorization. Handle channel verification before connecting another channel. Do not use for ordinary analytics requests when already connected.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_earnings_calculate
summary: Calculate estimated YouTube ad earnings from a number of monthly views, returning a low-to-high range in USD.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_edit_media
summary: Edit an existing video or audio file by trimming a clip, extracting audio, grabbing a frame or adjusting loudness. Returns the edited media as a new file.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_generate_broll
summary: Find free stock B-roll video clips.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_generate_clips
summary: Turn a long video, podcast or stream into short vertical clips with captions for Shorts, Reels and TikTok. Returns the created clips.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_generate_comment_replies
summary: Draft several possible replies to a YouTube viewer's comment, in different tones.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_generate_music
summary: Generate an original, royalty-free background music track from a description of the mood and style.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_generate_script
summary: Write a YouTube video script from a topic, title and research, for a Short or a video up to 60 minutes.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_generate_thumbnail
summary: Create a YouTube thumbnail from a video link, title or short description. Returns a generated thumbnail image.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_generate_titles
summary: Generate YouTube title ideas or rewrite an existing title, returning options with click scores.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_generate_video
summary: Create a short AI video from a text prompt or images, or edit an existing MP4 using a prompt.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_generate_video_chapters
summary: Generate YouTube chapter timestamps and titles from a video's captions, ready for its description.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_get_channels_by_ids
summary: Look up YouTube channels by known channel IDs and return their current subscribers, views and channel details.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_get_images
summary: See actual pictures: YouTube thumbnails and avatars, Instagram photos, Reel covers, and carousel slides. For Instagram use kind instagram_media with a post/Reel permalink or shortcode from earlier results; select the 1-based slide (default 1). Repeat a post with different slide numbers to read a carousel in order. Numeric Meta media IDs and CDN image URLs are not accepted. Photos and slides come back as labeled MCP images; a video slide returns its still image, not a video analysis. Private or unavailable public posts may not load. Use it when you need to look at a thumbnail or avatar but the app you run in can't open its image link, for example before you describe, compare or critique them.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_get_profile
summary: Identify the vidIQ account connected to this request. Use when the user asks which vidIQ account or email is connected, or wants to check whether they connected the intended account. Returns a stable opaque account ID and available display information, resolved from the authenticated connection.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_get_videos_by_ids
summary: Look up YouTube videos by known video IDs and return current views, likes, titles, tags and video details.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_ig_accounts_from_outliers
summary: Find Instagram creator/account candidates from existing outlier reel discovery.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_ig_profile
summary: Public data only. For the user's own performance, check `vidiq_instagram_connected_accounts` first for private insights. Look up a public Instagram account by handle: bio, followers, number of posts and profile picture.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_ig_profile_reels
summary: Public data only. For the user's own performance, check `vidiq_instagram_connected_accounts` first for private insights. Get an Instagram creator's latest Reels by handle, with views, likes, comments and cover images.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_instagram_connected_accounts
summary: List the user's Instagram accounts connected to vidIQ, including whether private insights and Reel publishing are available. Call first when the user asks about "my Instagram", "my Reels" or their own Instagram account. Insights and publishing permissions are independent.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_instagram_owner_insights
summary: Read Instagram owner data; requires OAuth insights access. Get platformAccountId from vidiq_instagram_connected_accounts.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_instagram_publish_reel
summary: Publish a video as an Instagram Reel or Trial Reel. Use only after the user approves the exact video, connected account, caption, regular or Trial setting, and AI-generated content label choice. Require publishingAvailable=true. Upload unsupported sources first using vidiq_video_upload. Do not publish drafts or suggestions without approval.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_instagram_tiktok_outlier_search
summary: Find breakout Instagram Reels and TikToks performing better than their creators' usual content. Returns niche examples to study hooks, formats and video ideas.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_job_poll
summary: Check a specific vidIQ job and return its current status and result when finished.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_jobs_list
summary: List the user's running and finished vidIQ jobs, including thumbnails, clips, videos and voiceovers. Returns jobs and their current statuses.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_keyword_research
summary: Research YouTube keywords and return search volume, competition, rising searches and long-tail keyword ideas.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_list_competitors
summary: List the YouTube competitor channels the user currently tracks in vidIQ.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_media_file_info
summary: Check a video or audio file and return its length, file size and dimensions.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_motion_graphics
summary: Create animated text and graphics as an MP4: kinetic typography, intro / outro / title cards, subscriber milestone and celebration cards (e.g. "250K SUBSCRIBERS"), lower-thirds, count-up stat counters, comparison cards, progress bars, bar charts and quote cards.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_outliers
summary: Find YouTube breakout videos that get far more views than their channel usually does. Returns unusually successful videos in a niche, including examples from smaller channels.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_refine_thumbnail
summary: Edit an existing YouTube thumbnail using instructions in plain language. Returns a revised thumbnail image.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_reply_to_comment
summary: Publish a public reply immediately to a comment on the user's own YouTube video. Call only after explicit approval of the exact channel, video, comment and final reply text. Never call for drafting; use vidiq_generate_comment_replies. Obtain comment identifiers from vidiq_video_comments. Requires owner access and comment permission. Verification is not publication.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_score_thumbnail
summary: Score a YouTube thumbnail from 0 to 100 for predicted click potential and return suggestions to improve it.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_score_title
summary: Score YouTube titles from 0 to 100 for their predicted click potential. Returns scores to compare existing title options.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_similar_channels
summary: Find YouTube channels similar to the user's channel or another named channel. Returns competitors and related creators to study.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_similar_thumbnails
summary: Find YouTube thumbnails that visually resemble a given thumbnail from a long-form video.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_submit_feedback
summary: Send a user's feedback, bug report or feature request to the vidIQ team.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_subscriber_insights
summary: Analyze subscriber overlap and best times to post for a YouTube channel you own.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_title_thumbnail_wins
summary: Find long-form YouTube videos (not Shorts) whose views per hour at least doubled after the creator changed the title, the thumbnail, or both. Use this when the user asks which title or thumbnail changes worked or raised views, for repackaging ideas, or for before/after examples, in a niche or across YouTube. For one video's change log, use `vidiq_video_change_history`. Only videos published in the last 3 months are covered.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_trend_categories
summary: List the available video formats and categories for breakout video searches, such as tier lists, reactions and video essays.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_trending_videos
summary: Find YouTube videos and Shorts going viral right now, ranked by views per hour. If no videos are returned, use `vidiq_outliers` for the same topic.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_update_competitors
summary: Add or remove YouTube channels from the user's tracked competitor list. Returns the result of the update.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_update_video
summary: Change a video title, description, complete tag list, privacy setting or scheduled publish time on the user's own YouTube channel. Call only after explicit approval of the exact channel, video and final values. Never call to draft, preview or recommend changes. Omitted fields stay unchanged; empty descriptions or tag lists clear them. Thumbnails require a separate tool.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_update_video_thumbnail
summary: Replace a thumbnail on the user's own YouTube video. Call only after explicit approval of the exact channel, video and final image. Never call to generate, preview or recommend thumbnails. Requires authorized owner access and a PNG or JPEG up to 2 MiB. Supply exactly one supported thumbnail input.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_user_channels
summary: Find the user's connected YouTube channels and return their subscribers and views.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_user_videos
summary: List the user's YouTube uploads from a connected channel, including public, unlisted and private videos.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_video_change_history
summary: Find when a YouTube video changed its title or thumbnail, including recorded thumbnail A/B tests. Returns a history of those changes.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_video_comments
summary: Read comments and replies on a YouTube video or channel and return viewer questions, complaints and feedback.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_video_earnings_estimate
summary: Estimate a YouTube video or Short's ad earnings as a low-to-high range in USD.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_video_stats
summary: See how a YouTube video's views, likes and comments have changed over time. Returns engagement trends to show whether a video is gaining momentum or slowing down.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_video_transcript
summary: Get a YouTube video's transcript or subtitles to summarize it, find the main takeaways, check exact quotes or write a description. Returns the video's original captions in their available language, for videos in any language that has captions.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_video_upload
summary: Import a video file or link into vidIQ for clipping, editing or analysis with other tools.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_video_watch
summary: Watch a YouTube video and return a scene-by-scene breakdown with timestamps, visual moments and editing details.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_voiceover_clone
summary: Clone the user's own voice from an audio sample for use in AI voiceovers.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_voiceover_clone_start
summary: Clone a consenting speaker's voice from a YouTube video for use in AI voiceovers.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_voiceover_generate
summary: Turn a script into an AI voiceover and return the narration as an MP3.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_voiceover_list_voices
summary: List available AI voiceover voices, including the user's cloned voices.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_watch_shortform_content
summary: Break down a Reel, TikTok or YouTube Short and return its transcript, scenes, hook and format.

name: mcp__codex_apps__vidiq_vidiq_youtube_search
summary: Search YouTube and return matching videos, channels or playlists.
